shipping_offer_evidence.quote: Free overnight shipping on all orders

shipping_wait.quote: After your prescription is written, your medication will be processed, and you will receive shipping and tracking information within 2 business days. You'll have unlimited access to our patient care team and providers for any questions. At the end of each month, you'll fill out a refill form to continue receiving your medication.

cancellation.value: SkinnyRx terms allow cancellation through the Customer Help Center, phone, or online account. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period and must occur at least five days before the renewal processing date; renewal may itself be charged up to five days before the next period. No partial-period refunds are promised. Branded-pathway membership fees are non-refundable. The homepage separately describes refunds before prescription review and cancellation before shipment preparation; do not substitute its general cancel-anytime wording for the terms' cutoff.
cancellation.quote:
Cancellation will take effect at the end of the current subscription period. Your subscription will automatically renew for another subscription period unless you cancel at least five (5) days before the applicable renewal processing date. Please note: We do not offer refunds for partially used subscription periods. However, SkinnyRx may provide refunds on a case-by-case basis at our sole and absolute discretion.

Any reference in this Section applies only to amounts charged by SkinnyRx and, where applicable, products fulfilled through SkinnyRx-controlled workflows. For branded medications, the applicable third-party pharmacy or manufacturer-affiliated program may have different processing, refill, billing, and shipping timelines. If a Provider determines that the requested branded medication is not appropriate for you, the branded medication workflow may be cancelled. Any SkinnyRx membership fee charged for access to branded medication is non-refundable. You may cancel the membership at any time, but the cancellation will apply prospectively beginning with the next billing period.

Injectable medications are administered directly into the body through a needle. This method provides very direct delivery into the bloodstream or tissues and is **administered once per week.**

Sublingual (oral) medications are taken by placing them under the tongue, where they dissolve and are absorbed through the mucous membranes into nearby blood vessels. It is **administered once per day.**
